What I searched:

- The file that should contain the answer is hr/headcount-2024.xlsx ({bench-cache}/data_room-full-chaos-d55f0fad24d9/project/docs/hr/headcount-2024.xlsx), but the indexer refused it as corrupt_input (ZIP central directory missing or truncated) so it was not read/indexed.

Because the headcount-2024.xlsx could not be read, I cannot retrieve the total headcount. To proceed, restore/replace that Excel file or allow partial ingest so it can be indexed.
